question: How can I make an accordion section expanded by default when the page loads?
ground_truth: To make an accordion section expanded by default, use the `defaultOpen` property and set it to `true`. For example: `<Accordion title="Section Title" defaultOpen={true}>Content</Accordion>`. This will ensure the accordion is open when the page loads.
